listing.name: Luddic Enhancement IED Ships
listing.summary: Adds explosive ships that detonate on impact, destroying nearby vessels.
listing.aiSummary: Adds explosive ships that detonate on impact, destroying nearby vessels.

description: Due to popular demand, I have split off the IED ships into their own mod. This mod does not need Luddic Enhancement, and Luddic ENhancement does not need this mod. This mod adds IED ships, specifically a dram, a phaeton, and a Prometheus, which explode, taking ships out in the near vicinity.
descriptionHtml: Due to popular demand, I have split off the IED ships into their own mod. This mod does not need Luddic Enhancement, and Luddic ENhancement does not need this mod. This mod adds IED ships, specifically a dram, a phaeton, and a Prometheus, which explode, taking ships out in the near vicinity.
aiDescription: Adds explosive ships that detonate on impact, destroying nearby vessels. Includes a Dram, a Phaeton, and a rare Prometheus variant with a built-in Dram bomb. These ships are designed to be used as suicide or area-denial units, increasing tactical options for the Luddic Church.
